question: What claim is made about the multiplicity of Kāmeśvarī’s great forms?
premises: Kāmeśvarī has great divisions or forms
These forms are many in number
Their existence is affirmed to Pārvatī
inference: Kāmeśvarī manifests in many great distinct forms.
plain_english: O Pārvatī, there are many great forms of Kāmeśvarī.
